title: Next release: plant gitHead in the packed launcher before qualification, and measure whether the registry keeps it
description: To Do. DO NOT START without plan approval. DEC-251 (a3): the preferred route for the NEXT release after 0.15.0. Plant gitHead=<released sha> in the launcher package.json BEFORE qualification, so the qualified bytes carry it (a planted gitHead changes the tarball sha256, which is why 0.15.0 could not take it without re-qualification). Measure whether the registry keeps a tarball gitHead on that release OWN rc publish, never by a publish made for the measurement: any real publish, scratch package included, is registry publication, tier 3, the operators. Local npm pack and npm publish --dry-run only show the tarball CAN carry it (QCLI-555 note). Until the registry is shown to serve it, release-provenance --post keeps the receipt-bound tarball route from QCLI-555.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The launcher package.json carries gitHead equal to the released sha before the candidate bundle is built, so the qualified launcher tarball already carries it
Whether the registry serves that gitHead for the rc is read from that release own rc publish and recorded; no publish is made for the measurement
release-provenance.mjs --post is changed only as far as that reading supports, and still fails when nothing ties the served bytes to the released commit
